verdict.rationale: Aircall's own pricing page says it routes incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling. That is exactly the 'press 1 for sales' story. The support rests on a single marketing line; the developer smart-routing tutorials are build-it-yourself primitives and are not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a support leader configures the menu (no-code builder, nested options, team assignment), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
